## Public beta: safe, explainable media automation

PyFFmpegCore {{ tag }} is the first public artifact for developers and technical
creators who need maintained FFmpeg workflows with capability preflight, exact
plans, explicit execution policies, structured results, and privacy-redacted
receipts. It requires separately installed `ffmpeg` and `ffprobe`; it is not an
arbitrary filter-graph DSL, hosted transcoder, or packet/frame API.

### Reproduce the demonstrated workflows

- [Preserve every video, audio, subtitle, attachment, and data stream](https://othmaneblial.github.io/pyffmpegcore/recipes/preserve-streams/)
- [Web-compatible editor/camera video](https://othmaneblial.github.io/pyffmpegcore/recipes/web-video/)
- [Fit a video under an exact upload limit](https://othmaneblial.github.io/pyffmpegcore/recipes/exact-size/)
- [Normalize spoken audio with measured loudness](https://othmaneblial.github.io/pyffmpegcore/recipes/podcast/)
- [Before/after media facts and redacted receipts](https://othmaneblial.github.io/pyffmpegcore/evidence/)

### Problems this release addresses

- Preserve rich-media tracks and metadata during a lossless remux instead of silently selecting one stream.
- Preview the exact argument vector and capability checks before a media file is changed.
- Diagnose FFmpeg/FFprobe availability and codec/filter gaps with actionable output.
- Carry the same typed pipeline from a local checkout into a pinned container or GitHub Action.
- Resume bounded batches and pipelines without silently reprocessing completed outputs.
- Share useful execution evidence without exposing absolute paths or hashing content by default.

### Compatibility and immutable evidence

- Exact release wheel validation: [{{ release_run_url }}]({{ release_run_url }})

- PyPI files expose the matching Trusted Publishing attestations after publication.
